headword: {学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}
reading: がくぎょうじょうじゅ
gloss: academic success; fulfillment of one's studies

definitions.gloss: academic success; fulfillment of one's studies
definitions.explanation: The successful completion of one's studies or academic goals. A common wish printed on good-luck charms (お守り) sold at shrines and temples, typically for students.

examples.japanese: {学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}のお{守|まも}りを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a good-luck charm for academic success.

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}で{学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}を{祈願|きがん}した。
examples.english: I prayed at the shrine for academic success.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}の{学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}を{願|ねが}って、{受験|じゅけん}{前|まえ}に{湯島天神|ゆしまてんじん}へ{参拝|さんぱい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: Wishing for my son's academic success, I visited Yushima Tenmangu shrine before his exams.

notes:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) meaning literally "studies-achievement-fulfillment". Commonly seen on {絵馬|えま} (votive tablets) and お{守|まも}り at shrines associated with learning, especially those dedicated to Tenjin ({菅原道真|すがわらのみちざね}), the deity of learning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}のお{守|まも}り: good-luck charm for academic success
- {学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}を{祈願|きがん}する: to pray for academic success
- {学業成就|がくぎょうじょうじゅ}を{願|ねが}う: to wish for academic success

RELATED WORDS:
- {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}: prayer for exam success — more specific (passing exams)
- {成績向上|せいせきこうじょう}: improvement in grades
